title: Energy Transmission in Strongly Pinned Networks
exact_target: Prove adequate transmission of energy in a heat-bath network when on-site pinning dominates the coupling between sites.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000836 (OWR-1598-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Large Scale Stochastic Dynamics (2007), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2007/42, pp. 2443--2530; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 14--15, printed pages 2456--2457.
strongly pinned chain; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The source distinguishes geometric obstructions from the strong-pinning potential obstruction and gives an asymmetrical-energy-transmitting condition for uniqueness. Much stronger and sufficient transmission are qualitative in the extract; a norm inequality or universal conductivity theorem is not supplied.
